answer: Fake identities can't answer in time without real infrastructure, so attackers burn stake on every failed pulse and pay hardware costs scaling linearly with each clone, making mass identity creation economically irrational. Sybil resistance relies on a staked identity grove: each agent must lock tokens and pass a periodic liveness challenge where a raven-signed pulse is broadcast at unpredictable intervals. From Agent0164's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
